categories.label: Painting
categories.description: Paint-based works, including oil, acrylic and watercolor.

categories.label: Drawing
categories.description: Works made with pencil, charcoal, ink or similar drawing tools.

categories.label: Photography
categories.description: Photographic works, whether captured digitally or on film.

categories.label: Print
categories.description: Printmaking works such as etchings, engravings, screenprints and woodcuts.

categories.label: Sculpture
categories.description: Three-dimensional works that are carved, modeled, cast or assembled.

categories.label: Illustration
categories.description: Images made to interpret a story, concept or subject, in any medium.

categories.label: Collage
categories.description: Works assembled from pieces of paper, photographs or other flat materials.

categories.label: Mixed Media
categories.description: Works intentionally combining two or more distinct media.

categories.label: Digital Art
categories.description: Works created or substantially composed using digital tools.

categories.label: Graphic Design
categories.description: Visual communication works such as posters, typography and layout design.

categories.label: Textile Art
categories.description: Artworks made with fibers or fabric, including weaving and embroidery.

categories.label: Ceramic Art
categories.description: Artworks shaped from clay and hardened by firing.

categories.label: Other Visual Art
categories.description: Use only when none of the listed work types accurately describes the work; explain the type in your description.
